batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c A Mithun b DL Vettori

batting.dismissal: c LA Pomersbach b V Kohli

batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b A Mithun

batting.dismissal: c A Mithun b S Aravind

balls.text: clobber goes MS Dhoni to another low full toss on the pads, Mithun has been all over the place, but this time it goes to the man at deep midwicket, 17 over the over
plays the lofted one-handed drive this time off a full ball going across, refuses the single again as long off cuts it off to his left

that is why he did not take the single, what a shot, some timing, some power, some combination, low full toss on the pads, Dhoni just flicks it with a huge backlift and the ball disappears over deep midwicket
the shovel off a very full delivery, weight goes on the back foot and the ball flies on the bounce to long on, he refuses the single
makes little difference as he keeps it one short of a length, Dhoni is ready, goes back and pulls it hard through square leg
this could turn out to be expensive for Bangalore, Dhoni sets himself up in the crease, gets back leg deep in the crease, and hammers a short of a length ball in to the crowd over deep midwicket
low full toss wide outside off stump, Dhoni gets forward and pushes it to keep the strike to the man on the edge of the circle at extra cover
the Karnataka seam duo combine to get Ashwin, short ball banged in, he went for the big pull over midwicket, but only got a top edge that Mithun took easily at deep square leg
Tiwary at short fine leg saves the boundary, gets down to his left quickly to stop the ball which Dhoni had swing with good timing
that will be fifty for the India captain, just takes a step or two towards the pitch of the length ball, and whips it with those powerful wrists high over deep midwicket
this one is on a length but some way outside off again, and he steers it to third man to give Dhoni the strike
bowls it a full and wide outside off stump, Ashwin was backing away outside leg, tries to reach out for it and misses
short ball, he rides the bounce to push it in front of point for another single
pushed away towards sweeper cover for a single

Zaheer takes the steepler, keeps his eyes on the ball all long, Morkel this time went for his favourite hitting zone over deep midwicket, but gets it off the toe end of the bat high in the sky, Zaheer watches it like a hawk at midwicket and takes a tumbling catch in the end
worked away off the hip and goes to short fine leg for the single
Dhoni gives it everything, length ball and he tries to kill it over deep midwicket, but the outside edge flies over third man for six, well then
Morkel goes for the big one over long off, but cannot get underneath the full delivery that much, and lofts it on the bounce to Tiwary running to his right from long off
huh, sprays this one full and wide past the left-hander, bounces way after it has passed the crease
shuffles in the crease and gets well outside the line of this one to work it off the pads wide of the man at long leg, enough for Dhoni to take two
crash! Dhoni gets one short of a good length, it does not get up much, around waist height, he transfers weight on the back foot and thumps the pull in front of deep square leg
wobbles in the air a shade, is fuller and wider outside off, he gets to the pitch and drives in the air wide of long off
goes for the forcing pull of a short ball that is too close to him for the shot, rolls away towards midwicket
stands in the crease and as the length ball aprroaches, he brings bat forward with some speed to send it along the ground to long off
back of a length and coming in with the angle, punched towards extra cover
worked away off the pads through square leg for a single
can;t get him away, he goes back to work it away right to midwicket
angles this outside off stump and across the left-hander who gets an outside edge to short third man as he goes for the drive
lunges forward to push a turning ball in front of covers for a single, just gets away with this everytime
tossed up ball turning in on the pads and he carefully tucks it away to square leg

Dan it is, the arm ball gets Bravo, tossed up around off and gets him to push forward outside the line for the turn, there isn't any turn, Bravo seemed to have got an inside edge on to pad, or did he, uimpire Hariharan through there was none, AB the ever-alert man had already got to the ball in front of Dwayne and taken the bails off, the ball would have just taken top off off
works a very full ball off the toes, and completes the second easily as he had charged through for the first and had enough time, apparently though they have run one short
pulled away to deep square leg off a short of a good length, Agarwal throws it on the bounce which gets too awkward for AB, and they take the overthrow
goes back to a ball turning in and pushes it in front of covers for a single
tries to slog him away through midwicket but cannot time it, gets it off the inside edge towards square leg
that'll do for Dhoni, that is his zone, full and just about enough in the slot for him to get underneath and he smokes it over the bowler's head
haah, Gayle gets feet in the way of a drive from Dhoni, stops the ball, finds Bravo in the way, and pushes him out of the way to pick up the ball, Dwayne smiles
this one keeps low and raps him on the pads, on the back foot, in front of leg, but Bravo holds up the bat to indicate there was an inside edge, not given
opens the face of the bat as he lurches forward to a length ball that comes on slowly, and gets it well fine past short third man in to the Chennai dug out
wobbles in the air and comes in full almost yorker length on off stump, dug back to the bowler

Virat Kohli picks up a wicket with a long hop, back of a length and sitting up, Saha had lots of options, bent the knee and played a swat-sweep kind of stroke that carried right to the man at deep square leg, Virat is smiling at his fortune, the ball got on a touch quickly to the batsman
slanted full and wide down leg, he misses the flick and AB has the bails off for effect
stabs him from a length past the man at point, sweeper cover will cut it off
angles it gently on to the pads and is whipped away to deep midwicket
almost yorks himself as he hustles around and tries to work it away through midwicket, but gets an inside edge on to pad
can't get underneath a flat and full one so he pushes it past extra cover for a single
tries the lap shot off a angled ball going down leg, almost carries to Zaheer at short fine leg, who labours to his left and dives to stop the ball
full delivery outside off stump and he drives it to extra cover
Chennai getting some sort of move-on here, Saha shuffles across, and gets a small tickle on one around leg stump to get it fine past the keeper
Saha gets maximum, the slog sweep, takes a step out, goes down on the knee, it is a flat and full ball so he goes flat and full over the man at deep midwicket
gets a full and wide ball outside off, but does not try to do much with it, just hangs beside the line and steers it to squarish third man
goes back to a back of a length ball and looks to push it past point for a single, cannot beat that man
short of a length outside off, he goes on the back foot and pushes towards sweeper cover
this angle suits him as it is ending on middle and leg, he shuffles to flick it off the pads in front of square leg
shuffles across and outside off stump looking to work it from off in to the leg side, he favours the on side a touch too much, leading edge that goes to covers
angles in the full ball, Dhoni is setting himself up for the big heave by camping deep in the crease, cannot get under this one and drives it along the ground to long on
pushes forward in unique fashion to earn a single down the ground to long off
beats him on the cut, turning in flat and very quickly, not far from off stump
high full toss which he surprisedly pushes away to midwicket
pushed away back to the bowler off the front foot
there goes Dhoni, gets a bit of air on the ball, full around off stump, and Dhoni cranks up for the big swing and hammers it with the turn way over long on
turning in from wide outside off and cut away hard to sweeper cover
this is excellent stuff from Dan, has Dhoni fully forward in honest defence as the ball rolls back down the track
lunges forward to push a length ball turning away to point
now he gets the leading edge that goes to the left of the bowler as he looks to flick a full ball off the pads
reaches out from the crease to a fuller one and pushes to extra cover
this one kicks a bit from a length, Dhoni goes in the back foot to defend it
goes deep in the crease to tuck a length ball through square leg
hangs his bat to a ball wide outside off and gets it away to third man
well bowled. 139.8 kph and bowled a bit wider and fuller outside off, he goes for the drive and is beaten as it just moves away a tad
Dhoni allows the length ball to come on and brings front foot forward to push it past covers for a single
gets forward to a length ball and finally gets it through covers for a single
Kaif in to the act again, he digs out a very full ball to Kaif's right and he cuts it off quickly
137.1 kph low full toss that he comes forward and drives in to the ground, Kaif at extra cover dives to his right to grab the ball low
Dhoni goes back to a shortish ball that is turning away and slices hard, the ball drops just to the right of the diving point fielder and runs in to the boundary beating sweeper cover
fuller ball and clipped away off the pads to deep midwicket
can;t get it away, slower through the air, he tries to work it on the leg side but cannot time it off the wicket
in a tangle as he fires it in on the pads, and he manages to turn it away to short fine leg
just comes forward and walks after dropping the ball in front of cover, Dhoni sends him back
lovely ball flighted and dipping on him outside off, he pushes it in the air but on the bounce to short extra cover
Dhoni goes for the big pull off a short ball dug in to the body, the outside edge rolls away towards point
overcooks the angle from round the wicket and it ends up on the pads, Saha shuffles to whip it away wide of long leg
comes in sharply with the angle from a length, he is some trouble as he stabs it back down the track
goes wide down the leg side in an attempt to bring the ball back in
gets front pad a long way forward and brings bat around it to drive a fuller one to mid on
stays deep in the crease to give himself as much time as possible and works it away off his pads through square leg
this is nippy stuff from Aravind, back of a length and angling away, gets it to cut back in a long way off the seam, he somehow manages to get an inside edge on it
flicks a fuller ball along the ground past midwicket for a single
pushes away a flatter ball in to the off side and sets off for the run, sent back by Dhoni

gone! Badri holes out to long off, he had decided to go over the top, was nowhere near the pitch of the ball as he came down the track, and just managed to loft it high in the air, Mithun came in from long off, got under the ball and took a well judged catch
tossed up ball has him reaching out for the drive, pushed away to extra cover
gets forward to push this length ball in front of cover for a quick single
short and wide to start with, and he cuts it easily into the gap between cover and point, got on top of the ball and played it late to find the gap
beaten, goes for the forcing cut to a short and wide ball going further away, and misses
again that man gully comes in to play, Badri stays beside the line to steer a widish one to him
guides a back of a length ball to gully on the bounce

this is super stuff from Zaheer, 136.4 kph, Badri gets forward to a length ball for the extra cover drive, but the ball moves in a long way to strike him on the pads, the appeal is turned down, Gayle makes the sign for the referral, it would have just clipped off
hangs in the crease and allows the length ball to come on around off, then takes a step forward and defends

Raina departs, he tries to launch in to the big slog-swat over deep midwicket, the short ball hurries on to him, he is late on the shot and gets a big top-edge that goes in to the hands of point, Zaheer first looks incredulously at Raina for attempting that kind of shot off him, then gives a send-off
Aravind is not giving anything away, another back of a length ball on the body, he tries to get around it and work it in to the leg side but cannot time it
gets hit on the thigh pad as he misses the waft in to the leg side, ball rolls away to extra cover, he thinks about a single but then wisely withdraws back
the angled ball across the right-hander that got Vijay, Badri shuffles a lot more and gets outside the line to tuck it in front of square leg
tries the bouncer, loops up gently from short of a length and goes a foot down the leg side

Aravind gets Vijay, reward for being consistent around off stump, on a length and moving across him, Vijay goes for a poke at it from the crease and gets a healthy edge which AB gets to diving in front of first slip
flicked off the pads elegantly and gets it past square leg, Pomersbach comes in from deep midwicket and puts in the dive, but he has touched the ropes
patted down the track from a short of a good length, just shuffles in the crease and defends it off the back foot
gets forward to a length ball and drives it to wide mid off
more away movement from Zaheer, superb control, pitches outside off and moves away from Raina
similar ball outside off but not bouncing much, he gets forward and leaves
beaten outside off this time as Zaheer drags the length back a little and gets it to bounce a bit more outside off, Raina tries to go for a forcing drive but is beaten
there are two men in the point region, but Raina manages to get it between those two, coming forward and opening the face to send the full ball racing in to the gap
bowls this one in the channel outside off stump again and bounces as it zips away, Raina watches it closely and shoulders arms

Zaheer holds his arms aloft and celebrates, he has done Hussey in here, it was that delivery on a fuller length and lurking close to off stump, Hussey decided to go hard at it from the crease and the inside edge clatters in to off stump
tries to work him away off the hip, but cannot get the timing on it and Aravind goes to his right to field, excellent over from the Karnataka seamer
carefully gets behind the line of one angled across him and pushes it away to covers
the angle from over the wicket takes it on to his pads and he clips it away to square leg
gets away this time with a single towards midwicket
gets beaten as he goes wafting at a short of a length ball outside off stump
starts off on a length and angles it across the batsman who defends it quietly down the track

gets the outside edge with that consistent away movement from a very full length as Hussey goes for the drive, but it flies quickly past slips, Mithun at third man comes charging to his right to save the boundary
prodigious away movement from Zaheer, but after that chat with the umpire, delivered from wide of the crease and it is called a wide
a touch wider outside off stump this time, similar length, but Hussey hangs in the crease and watches it seam away
lovely delivery, Zaheer is targetting the fuller length, close to off stump, excellent seam position, makes him go for the drive and beats him as it zips away late
on a fuller length and around that off stump, he comes forward and pushes it out towards point
tries the yorker, it comes in full around leg stump, Vijay manages to get an inside edge that takes the ball behind square
low full toss around off stump and he pushes it away to deep mid on
that will be it, Bangalore finish top of the table with a work off Gayle's pads down to long on
more brutal, backs away from short of a length ball, and cracks it off the back foot and it flies flat and fast in to the wide long off boundary
Gayle wants this one done and dusted soon, gives this one a fearsome thump, and sends it soaring over wide long on
cut off the back foot past point for a single
Tiwary continues to struggle, plays out a length ball in front of midwicket, Gayle wants the run, Tiwary sends him back, Gayle manages to get in the way of the throw as it comes in
dropped Gayle went back in the crease and in an attempt to whip it away, looped it straight back to Raina, it went to Suresh at waist height, went in and went out
Gayle gets a length ball and calmly eases it away to long on past the non-striker
142.4 kph back of a length ball again, he is late on the pull and awkwardly gets it down in the air to long on, it has been a long struggle for him today
hops on his toes to another back of a length ball hurrying on to him, this one bounces even more and he manages to stab it away
Tiwary cannot do anything with a back of a length ball banged in with the angle, and defends it on the off side close to the pitch
reaches out and stabs a full and wide delivery in front of cover for another single
bowls it full on the pads attempting the yorker and he picks it away in front of square leg
good delivery to end a wayward over, fired in to the blockhole, Gayle digs it back to the bowler
pushed back to the bowler from leg stump
Raina has lost his line totally here, fires in another one wide down leg from round the wicket
direct hit and Tiwary was struggling, it was tucked towards Bravo at midwicket, who fired in the throw even as they went for the single, just missed at the non-striker;s
he does not have to do anything with this one as it is fried way wide down the leg side
is clueless what to do with one fired in wide down leg, tries to paddle it away and misses
can't get it away, works it off the pads to square leg
darted in on the pads and pushed away on the leg side
finally Tiwary manages to get one away, gets to the pitch of a full ball and shows the full face of the bat as he lofts it one bounce in to the straight boundary
gets a thick outside edge as he gets forward to drive with a flourish, single to third man
Tiwary tries to go over the sightscreen, but ends swinging way inside the line of a ball outside off, bat turns in his hands and one hand comes off the bat too
makes him go on his toes to keep down a back of a length ball dug in to the body
goes for the crunching cut but mistimes it in to the ground, but will still get the single to sweeper cover
the other version of Gayle, the watchful one, lets it go outside off stump
why bother about singles, when Gayle can just clear front leg, get under the full pitched ball and send it soaring it way over the long on boundary
Tiwary tries to make room and cuts from middle stump but straight to point
good work from Badri at extra cover, runs to his left and dives to prevent the single off the drive
tight over so far, gets forward to drive a flighted ball to extra cover
stays in the crease to work one through midwicket
gets away does Gayle, it was tossed up and he wanted to go over long on but got an inside edge on to the pads, got back before Dhoni got to the ball
fired in full on the pads and tucked away to square leg
shuffles and stands around off stump to drive a fuller ball along the ground to long off
now he goes back to being watchful, and leaves a length ball outside off alone

outside edge, but well past the keeper and well wide of third man as well, that is the 50 for Gayle, he stood in the crease and reached out to a full and wide on, getting the edge to the fine boundary
gets width outside off stump and guides it past backward point to third man
walks towards the pitch of this length ball outside off and drives to Raina at extra cover who hits the stumps but Gayle is in comfortably
slants it in outside off from wide of the crease from round the wicket, Gayle plonks front foot out and leaves carefully
walks down the track and whacks the short of a length ball past Bolllinger at midwicket, there is man in the deep and they get a couple
that line is only for gayle, to Tiwary he is on a length on the stumps and Tiwary pushes it away on the off side
goes full and wide outside off again, but Gayle is prepared this time and digs it out forcefully, it hits Jakati at extra cover who cant stop it and concedes the run
sprays another one full outside off, but this one is too wide and is called one
angled full and wide outside off stump which Gayle watches go past him
positive from Tiwary, gets well forward and drives past extra cover down the ground for a single
swipes it from a length outside off stump and gets it past the bowler to long on
Albie doesn't want to give Gayle in his hitting zone, but in an attempt to go full and wide of the batsman he sprays well wide and it bounces after it has passed the crease
beaten again, can;t get bat to ball, goes driving from the crease to one floated a touch wide outside off, and misses by some way
bowls it from wide of the crease in to Tiwary who adjusts to play it back to the bowler, can Chennai come back with some quiet overs?
goes for the square drive to one a touch wide outside off but straight to point
now has him pushing forward to another one in the channel outside off, he is beaten totally
shoulders arms again, this time to a length ball a foot outside off stump
punches a back of a length ball hard to sweeper cover
Morkel is a bit charged up now, runs in with purpose and deliveries one going across from short of a length, Tiwary shoulders arms
now he gets a wicket, it is Virat who departs, shuffles across the stumps, and flicks off the hip straight to short fine leg, couldn't have found that man any better if he had searched for him
plays out a short of a length ball on the off side

there goes Chris,this is almost inevitable, it is the short ball, he tries to fire it in as he sees him backing away, but Gayle's fearsome pull murders the ball over deep midwicket still, cruelly effective
driven off the front foot to long off for a single

and is taken out first ball, Gayle stands motionless but as the full ball comes close he explodes in a flurry of action, bashing it back, Morkel is midway through his followthrough as the ball crashes in to his shin, goes down immediately, he is having trouble standing up, that would have hurt a lot

now they steal a leg bye, it was fired in full on the pads, could have gone down leg, as Gayle pushed forward, even as the ball rolled in to the leg side everyone was busy appealing, so the batsmen decided to trot across
poor ball, short, does not get up much, and GAyle cashes in now, swivelling to pull it well in front of the man at deep square leg
Suresh concedes a run, it was pushed back to him, and he tried to back-flick it on to the stumps, missed and they crossed over
there is no respite for Chennai, Virat cashes in on a short and wide ball turning in, gets back and has enough time to delay the cut shot and get it past the backward point fielder
gets a leading edge as he comes down the track to work a full delivery away
fired wide down leg side from round the stumps
in to the second tier right away, tossed up, full and in his slot, Gayle explodes in a huge followthrough to send it soaring in to the crowd over the sightscreen
nudges off the pads down towards long on to keep the strike
worked away this time towards midwicket for a single
Bravo goes theatrical to stop a defensive push from Kohli, goes flying to his left horizontally to grab the ball and comes down crashing
slower one hanging in the air before pitching on a fuller length at 113.4 kph, Gayle waits for it and eases it down to long off
Virat reaches out a long way to get to a very wide short ball and gets it wide of sweeper cover
tries to get beside the line of this length ball and guide it wide of point but it goes straight to that man there
banged in very short and goes over the batsman;s head
Ashwin tries a legbreak sort of delivery that goes short of a length outside off and he punches it away to sweeper cover off the back foot
darts it full on the pads and he picks him away in front of square leg
tossed up around off, Gayle is not taking any chances, and defends on the off side
reaches out to drive a fuller one back to Ashwin who goes down on his right to stop it
shuffles to tuck a length ball in front of square leg
short of a length and turning away, punched down to long off
gets this one fine off the pads, strays in that direction from a length, and is picked away to the fine boundary
hops on the toes to work it off the hip in front of square leg
supreme stroke from Virat, opens the face to drive a delivery going across over covers, got front leg a bit away, opened up, went hard at it, and managed to look stylish, superb
tight line close to off stump, and Virat pushes it away towards extra cover from the crease
hanging in the crease eyeing the deep midwicket boundary, but this one is darted in on a length and he quietly works it away through midwicket
works away a short of a good length ball to deep square leg
lovely ball, hanging in the air for a long time, makes Gayle indecisive, whether to push or leave, he tries a bit of both and is beaten as it turns away
shout for a catch, Gayle was looking to help this one fine around the corner, the ball bounces extra, and Dhoni lunges forward to take it off the thigh pad, Chennai think it is bat but Rudi does not

Albie at mid off saves a certain four, Virat had gone on the back foot and punched very late in to the gap between extra cover and point, but Albie ran hard to his left and threw himself towards the ball
thick-edged away to short third man off the front foot
turns away from a flatter trajectory and from a good length, he looks to sweep from way outside off and misses
full delivery on middle and he works it down to long on

thump goes CH Gayle, that is not a bad delivery, but this is a short ground, and Gayle is in the mood, dangerous for the bowler, picks it up casually from back of a length and pulls it contemptuously over deep midwicket, does not seem to go hard at them, but they fly away nevertheless
still more short of a length stuff, ending up high around off stump, he keeps the bat high in the air and guides it to third man
shot! Virat Kohli with a stunning cut, shortish and wide outside off, he waits on the back foot and cracks it off the middle of the blade, two men at point, one of them even dives, all in vain
goes for the forcing pull to a ball that is not short enough, ends up way outside leg and the ball goes on the bounce to deep mid on
well bowled, he backs away again and Dougie targets the stumps with the low full toss, he just gets the bat down in time to get it away towards midwicket
there goes Gayle, makes some room outside leg, and goes hard at a short of a good length ball, and slices it high over third man, there was a man there, it cleared him by miles
superb over, almost had him, this guy is relentless, this one is hanging in the air for a while, has him pushing at it in the air, almost carried to AShwin
tries to whip it away off the back foot but ends up pushing it back to the bowler
goes hard at another full ball, but Bravo is there at long on and runs across to cut it off
slows it down and tosses it up, he pushes it away off the front foot
fired in full on off stump, and Gayle clobbers it, one bounce in to the boundary over the bowler's head, huge backlift, and without a twitch in the face
lovely delivery from round the stumps, draws him forward and then turns it across the forward push
good over from Bollinger, short of a length and close to the off stump, can't do much with it and plonks it down close to the wicket on the off side
good stuff from Dougie, makes Virat go down under a surprise bouncer, he loses his footing and totters around in the crease
slanted very full and very wide outside off, he has no reason to go for it, as it is a wide
short ball going across, he wants to have a pull off this one, but is late on it, and gets an underedge on the bounce to the keeper
shot from Virat, gets to the pitch of a fuller one going across and pings mid off with a confident drive
short of a good length pegs him on the back foot and he defends it on the off side
hangs his bat tamely at a length ball zooming in around off and gets a thick edge to third man
he gets front foot out to a flatter one and drives it to long off for a single
goes back to one that turns in and works it in front of square leg
Virat shows how it is done, takes a moment to judge the length of this one, gets to the pitch, it is the full one going across, and he drives it along the ground past extra cover

AB looks to go over extra cover, is nowhere close to the flighted ball that moves away in the air, drags the back foot out, Dhoni takes no time in removing the bails, foot is on the line, and he is a goner
straight length ball which he blocks back to the bowler
moving away in the air, carrom ball to start with, goes full, dips and beats him on the dive outside off
